notes.title: SHRIMP GAME playtest all weekend!
notes.content:
The SHRIMP GAME online playtest is open to all Steam users from May 3rd 9 AM EST to May 5th 10 PM EST!
Press the "request access to the playtest" button on the Store page!
Host a game or hop in a public / a friends game and get to krilling!!
Expect bugs ;)
